reviews.title: VERY WORST AIRLINES OMAN AIR
reviews.text: Oman Air very worst airlines, especially the ground crews in Kuwait, very tragic what happened to us and imagine we traveling with our kids
reviews.author: Ernesto D

reviews.title: Uncomfortable seat
reviews.text: The seat was to narrow and uncomfortable specially for an adult. Food was not exceptional although my flight was just short.
reviews.author: Sally K

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: They rescheduled my flights 4 days (both departure and return) without any apologies or informing the reason or compensation.
reviews.author: Truong H

reviews.title: Worst of worst airline
reviews.text: Our journey started in Copenhagen and ends in Colombo. Have two connecting flights first one at Frankfurt international airport and the other one at Muscat Oman. We were delayed from our first flight even though it was there inside the country passengers weren’t allowed to get out for like 20/30 min. Then there was a huge security check-in and passport check line inside the airport and the airport itself is a very huge lot of walking. So since we got delayed from our first flight we were delayed to reach the next flight operated by Oman airline but still, there were 5min left before taking off and the flight was in front of us but there were three ladies who were there working for Oman airline didn't allow us to board. Us means it was not only me. There were another family and two people who traveled on the same flight and had the same problem. Later when we asked for rebook they asked us to pay again the full amount and have to wait another day until the next flight or another few days for another flight. We can't go in or out. No accommodations were provided for a rebooking refund. Simply they didn’t do anything. Customer service was terrible as hell. They were like if they didn't like to go and post on social media they don't mind. They literally said to go and post on Twitter or any other social media platform about the issue with no problem but they can't help but do something on their own. I even have the recording of customer service persons call to us. And also forgot to mention I was taking some videos from the flight while we were waiting so they can't deny that they were delayed. They wanted the other family to pay 28000kr for the flight but no refund for the canceled one. These people were very unfair, unbelievable, and also very rude and unprofessional. I mean they don't even care about the bad reputation they are going to get. There was no fault from our side we even checked in at least they could have announced our names or Inform. Nothing like that. We were only able to get into the airport from the flight was 30 min after which was around 9.10/15. Then had to take buses and trains and go through huge checking lines even tried to cut the line but weren't allowed for that. So who's fault is it.
reviews.author: Sawa

reviews.title: OMAN AIR: Willful deception???
reviews.text: On April 26, 2023 I made a flight booking with OMAN Air (Paris - Perth - Paris) via EXPEDIA and took a screenshot of the cancellation policy (fees: 100 €) during the booking process. After completing the booking, I received the OMAN AIR fare conditions (cancellation fees: €300). A phone call to Expedia regarding the different cancellation fees was answered by customer service with the words "There's nothing we can do about it!". On May 30, 2023, I received an email from EXPEDIA saying “Oman Air has changed your flight details. There is a need for action. Call us so we can find a new flight for you. If you don't want to travel, click 'Cancel'.” I then called EXPEDIA on May 31, 2023 to find a new flight. In addition, I was repeatedly promised free cancellation in the event of an inadequate flight rebooking. When EXPEDIA still hadn't sent me an adequate flight rebooking 24 hours later, I used the "free cancellation option" and clicked the "Cancel" button. After calling "EXPEDIA" again regarding the duration of the full refund, I was told that I had to pay a cancellation fee of €300 - this would have been decided by OMAN AIR. Despite EXPEDIA's clear and repeated "verbal or telephone" promise regarding a free refund, I have to pay the €300 cancellation fee myself and will receive the "reduced" refund in 12 weeks......!
reviews.author: Jan Peter H

reviews.title: Very good experience!
reviews.text: It was the first time for me with Oman Air and I absolutely loved it! I was very tired and hungry after a long precious flight and the flight attendants Ma Joudr and Ms Noukir were so kind and polite! The plane was clean and made me feel relaxed. I would personally recommend this company!
reviews.author: Anna B

reviews.title: Pathetic Airlines - NEVER TAKE IT GUYS
reviews.text: OMAN Airlines and its staff is pathetic at best. They are extremely rude & arrogant as if they are doing some kind of charity by flying their passengers. They delayed our flight by 12 hrs at Munich airport on 15th May and didn't provided with as basic as water or food & all shops were closed at airport at 11:00pm leaving all passengers in extremely inhuman situation. The saddest part is they didn't even bother to say sorry or be emphatic. 0/ZERO CUSTOMER ORIENTATION. I also see many of their flights were hugely delayed, even at Muskat airport, many passengers on various flights were having a hard time with delays. They served NON-VEG food even after telling Veg. food, that too chiken & pork, and they called it as veggies food. What a stupid staff they have ... This happened on Munich to Muskat flight 10:00am departure on 16th May OMAN AIRLINES # PATHETIC, INHUMAN, ARROGANT, CHEAP AIRLINE.... Will never ever fly again. Guys stay away from OMAN at any cost. We were aware of their bad reviews but since we were booked by Thomas Cook for our Europe trip we had no choice, but don't ever take OMAN Airlines if you really wish to reach on time Or enjoy your journey.
reviews.author: Europe Traveller

reviews.title: Worst flight ever
reviews.text: Had the worst flight ever. From Mascate to Munich on the 5th of May. The cabin crew Sara and Hye Kyung were very mean, unprofessional, inhuman. During the checkin we were told twice that we could change the seats. Sara also before entering the plane told us when they will finish the set up that there are some places left empty that can be used. Just before take off, I went in the front line with my baby because the seats were empty she came with Hye Kyung to tell me that I cannot seat. No one used the seats during the whole flight. My baby who has some difficulties to sleep in planes couldn’t sleep. The thing that If we used the seats few minutes he could have fallen asleep because it was quieter up front and there was more room. She refused to let me sit down while before she told me I could have changed my seat. She lied to me, she did nothing to help us with the baby (we have 2 kids). She was careless, inhuman as I spent hours in the toilets to make him asleep. Thank you Sara, thank you Oman Air. Last time flying with your company. I felt like sh**, no empathy, no attention, no service.
reviews.author: Hibu

reviews.title: Very bad airline
reviews.text: Worst airline, very expensive and yet substandard in all services that even low cost airlines will stand better. Hidden online booking tricks that would lead you to pay extras at the airport for luggage and other basic needs. I do not recommend this airline at all , try to avoid it, dirty planes, bad customer service, inefficient check in and lame ignorant and arrogant staff.
reviews.author: Moh M

reviews.title: Worst food
reviews.text: We flew from Bangalore to Dubai via Muscat,check in was smooth, flight was okay, crew were good but the food was terrible, when there is no choice they should provide some decent food.
reviews.author: A J

reviews.title: Horrible experience!
reviews.text: My luggage was off loaded and i was made to wait for a long time even after the complaints! Worst airline services i have ever experienced.
reviews.author: Liu

reviews.title: Fine flight
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised about the service by Oman Air. The booking, check-in process was efficient and comfort during the trip was good. I enjoyed the excellent food (not greasy) and entertainment (choice of movies) during the flight. Attendants were helpful and friendly. The flight was on schedule. The reason I was rather hesitant to book Oman Air was and is that generally speaking when something goes wrong in the Middle East, few staff take responsibility and communication is usually a nightmare. Anyway during this trip everything went smoothly.
reviews.author: Robert O

reviews.title: Refund
reviews.text: Worst airplane ever. I have booked my ticket due to visa rejection requested for refund and they have fully cancelled my ticket and made as non refundable. They won’t even respond to calls too.
reviews.author: Varghese G

reviews.title: Exchange a ticket is a big joke!
reviews.text: I wanted to change my return ticket for an emergency. I actually bought a ticket with this company because they offer one exchange fees for free. Listen, my original return Paris-phuket-Paris is around 960 euros. When I try to change it on the website, the Phuket-Paris the 3rd may 2023 is around 150 euros more than my original. So this is what I'am suppose to pay if I change my date. BUT the website doesn't work when I want to confirm the exchange. The application is even worse!! it is written on it that I did not take my first flight, with is false!! They ask me for the exchange 2300 euros to fly back around the 21th!!!!!!!! 3 times the price of a new ticket!!!!! No logic, no service, just cheaters. Never again I'll trust them! This offer for a free exchange fees is a big trap!
reviews.author: Cyrus C

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: This is the second time I've flown with Oman air and I was just as impressed as the first. Their flights are always time, easy check in, comfortable seats, tasty food, friendly staff, big selection of movies on board. They will definitely be one of my top choices when booking in future.
reviews.author: Kelly G

reviews.title: No customer service in Australia still one week email them no response at all .
reviews.text: I booked tickets online , its almost 2 weeks no response via email or call and Australian number not working. Worst airline ever i seen dont recommend anyone to book . With kids never book worst airlines ever . Don’t recommend ever to someone
reviews.author: Suhel Vahora

reviews.title: Long way to Bali
reviews.text: Have waited several months before posting this report and decided it’s time, also Oman air is ignoring my dozen of mails I have sent recently regarding a future booking. Travelling RT to Bali from Paris CDG with a long stopover in MCT which I was aware of but happy about it, knowing the lounge from a previous trip and very enjoyable. Only minutes before boarding in CDG I received an alert that my flight to KUL would be belayed by almost 5 hours then missing my MH connection to Denpasar. Contacted the gate agent who confirmed me that my original booking was still on, so embarked releived. The business class cabin was entirely full and all 30 seats were occupied in this B787-9. Sadly they run out of champagne we even had left the gate yet as they were taking orders for after departure drinks. Bad planning on such a route where champagne is traditionnally in great demand. Being still at gate contact they could have easily asked for a few more bottles, disappointing. Service overall was very friendly and professionalon all four segments, the food and presentation exquisite. Only on the first segment did I receive the original business class amenity kit, on the other three it consisted of a small bag with eye mask and few other small items, very similar to the one given in Economy. What I found strange and despite being featured on the menus on all 4 segments, I was (all other guests neither) never asked or offered the pre-arrival snack ; It’s not that I was particularly hungry but the gesture of asking would have been appreciated. Upon arriving in MCT I asked at the lounge desk about my connection to KUL and confirmed the flight is delayed and that I would miss my connexion to Bali and resulted a 18 hours transit stay in the lounge. As a Business class traveller and Silver Sindbad member I was never offered a hotel or one of their private room within the lounge. Followed an endless ordeal regarding my missed connexion and how to deal with it. I was sent to an office at the other side of the airport who was completly helpless, sending me back to the lounge and as shifts changed had to explain my case all over again. After almost a full day in the lounge finally embarked on the KUL bound flight and was met on arrival by an Oman air representative with a boarding pass for the following day and a hotel room within the airport for 17 hours. Inquired about my luggage and was told they would follow with the new flight. After three days finally arrived in Bali with the guaranty my luggage would be there and no, they were missing !! Filled a report at the airport and was really upset after this ordeal that after what I went through, the least I would expect is that my luggage were there. Only got them two days later they were delivered to my hotel in Ubud. Return trip went unvently well no complains. I still consider Oman air as a great airline and would not hesitate to recommand it ; Great improvments are to be achieved in regards to communications and public relations.
reviews.author: Grog35

reviews.title: Wow!!!
reviews.text: This poor excuse for the airline is below zero.Continuos cancellations.Non existent customer service.Overall I have no idea how this "airline " is still operating and having some business.?
reviews.author: Dominik G

reviews.title: Worst customer service ever
reviews.text: Oman is a wonderful country, one of the best in the world, lovely people, great food and gorgeous sceneries, it’s a place that is worth visiting at least once in a lifetime. I had the luck of visiting it many times and I always felt like at home. In my career I travelled in almost 80 countries, and I used the service of so many airline companies that I cannot remember the number. Well, I never experienced such a bad customer service, like the one of Oman Air, saying it’s the worst in the world won’t be enough to describe it. On a short flight from Dubai to Muscat, they seriously damaged my baggage and the only thing they could say, at Muscat Airport, their hub, was that they considered it as a “minor damage” even if my trolley was barely unusable. They gave me a mail address to contact which I did, but the mail came back as I wasn’t present in the “list of senders allowed to contact them”. After this, all the contacts I was given didn’t give me any kind of feedback. I replaced my luggage at my own expenses eventually, and I didn’t hear anything from them anymore. It's not that important, my values remain unchanged and much stronger than the ones of Oman Air. I will keep visiting Oman in the future, but I will never use Oman Air again in my life and I strongly recommend you do the same.
reviews.author: JamesPurple

reviews.title: Fraudulent behaviour and complete lack of support once they have your money
reviews.text: Unfortunately we booked 2 x multi city tickets through Oman Air. My booking was contingent to having accommodation for the long layover (14+ hours, as no shorter option was available for us to book online) and on the ability to change dates free of charge on the same fare, under economy prime. Before purchasing the tickets I called the HQ to clarify both points aand they confirned: 1. Yes, free accommodation was available for layover of 8+ hours ("just call us back after booking with a ticket reference number - and we'll provide you with a voucher") 2. No extra fees apply for prime economy if I find the same fare. So i was encouraged to go ahead and book with confidence. Surprise surprise! 1.When I provided the booking ref requesting the voucher - they apologized stating i was given a wrong info. 2. And to change dates i had to pay higher fees (even though i sent them screenshots showing the fare was unchanged on my side). They simply apologized for their mistake and encouraged me to escalate via a complaint. The complaint representative simply washed their hands clean, urging me to deal with the call center. I politely asked for a direct number to discuss via phone rather than email, and they simply stopped replying (2 weeks and counting with no aknowledgment to my follow ups). This feels like a FRAUDULENT BEHAVIOUR to lure customers into booking, and simply ghost them once they pocket the money. Oman Air aknowledged their call centre provided incorrect info based on which i made a booking, but refuse in any way to take ownership and rectify the mistake their incompetence has caused. I STRONGLY ENCOURAGE ANYONE PLANNING TO FLY WITH OMAN AIR, to steer clear and choose a reputable airline instead.
reviews.author: Veronica C

reviews.title: Baggage handle broken
reviews.text: On the way from bombay india via muscat oman air on board flight the travel was pleasant even after several times request for water arrived late . ON arrival at london heathrow my baggage handle was broken on collection I did requested for claim but refused and advised to feedback online . Online support was not great refused to accept claim mentioned no wear and tear but my bag handle was broken due to troughing the luggage and this has stress me out as this was just 3 yrs old bag very disappointment by the service over all
reviews.author: pavan k

reviews.title: Good flight but hopeless customer service
reviews.text: Good flight but hopeless customer service. We booked and paid for extra legroom seats from the pictogram on their site. The reality was very different. we had cramped seats with no legroom against a bulkhead. We had an acknowledgement of our complaint from customer services, then in spite of three further requests we have been ignored.
reviews.author: Tony J

reviews.title: Very disappointing experience and Customer service completely unreliable
reviews.text: Prior to purchasing my tickets, I contacted the call center seeking confirmation on a couple of points, on which they reassured me. After purchasing my tickets, it turns out all the information I was provided with was incorrect, leaving me and my husband hundreds of dollars out of pocket. Oman Air only provided an apology without taking any accountability nor honoring their word. I have been flying intercontinental for decades and never came across such poor customer service and complete disinterest from a carrier.
reviews.author: Veronica C

reviews.title: Customer service unreliable and fraudulent
reviews.text: First of all, the Dubai-Phuket flight carried out with a full plane and with only two bathrooms available for a 6-hour flight. Endless queue for the toilets and even the Crew agreed on the incorrect management of the flight. I also had to cancel my return flight scheduled for 12/31/22 and by phoning the customer center in Bangkok they told me I would get a refund of approximately $250 per ticket (2) Following my countless requests for reimbursement, they later informed me that I was not entitled to anything and that at most I could use the canceled flight without specifying the date of use. But the terms of the contract instead provide for the partial refund based on the IATA conventions but this company has not yet solved my problem. At this point I will contact IATA and consumer protection associations.
reviews.author: Fabrizio e Francesca

reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: Firstly I personally think that Oman Air should be considered among the top class middle eastern airlines and without a doubt best value for money. I completed this journey over 2 legs. DXB to MCT, MCT to LHR. The fact that they offer light food on an hour flight shows very good customer care where a lot of airlines would charge a fee or not even have an option. The second leg was over 7 hours and the flight was made very comfortable thanks to the service, cleanliness and leg room. The 787 aircraft was brand new with dimmable windows. Again, the flight started off with snacks and a drink (some airlines have omitted this), followed by a meal and tea/coffee service and finished with a sandwich and cake box. If there is one thing to improve, it would be the onboard entertainment, but this is me being very picky. Overall a very good product and hope they can keep this up.
reviews.author: Voyager769766

reviews.title: New charges for bulky luggage such as skis and golf bags
reviews.text: I recently travel by business class to Milan on Oman Air. The outward journey was flawless. As i checked in on the return trip, i was told by the duty check in manager that I would have to pay for my ski bag. The new charges has just come in that day. I made my bookings some three months prior and had received no word for Oman Air regarding this ridiculous charge. The charges would exceed the cost of 4 sets of new skis. I dug my heels in and refused to pay and finally he relented. So travelers beware. I don't know of other airlines charging other business class passengers for sporing goods. my advice, check out Singapore Airlines.
reviews.author: Jkhoo1

reviews.title: terrible service bunch of liars stealing money
reviews.text: worst service,liars,money stealing bunch,lost my luggage for 2 weeks,then delivered damaged did not compensate for delays or damaged luggage despite numerous complaints
reviews.author: a k

reviews.title: Amazing crew but
reviews.text: I really like to give Oman air a fantastic review as the crew on all our 4 flights were amazing but the service, more towards their meals service was a let down…a massive let down. The inconsistency in their products offered was mind boggling. Some flight were offered amenities kit and pyjamas, while other nothing whatsoever and without explanation. Some flight with Amouage amenities kit while the other some cheap nasty cloth bag. The meal services were chaotic on the flight back. One side of the aisle crew offered passengers breakfast while on my aisle, crew only taking order for refreshment consisting of coffee and biscuits. So while fellow passengers next to me having breakfast, I can only watch with my coffee and biscuits. Strange. The top it off, the flight was late into Frankfurt and we missed our connecting flight with Lufthansa to Amsterdam on a one ticket booking. However when Lufthansa tried to contact Oman air for authorisation to rebook the flight due to Oman air delay, no response from Oman air. Customer service non existence. We finally managed to get rebooked on our connecting flight with Lufthansa and this is all with fantastic help from Lufthansa side with no assistance from Oman air at all. Lufthansa mentioned that Oman air have treated us badly considering we are travelling with 2 elderly relative. Shocking how they treated their passengers especially when travelling in premium class.
reviews.author: kaminski

reviews.title: Little camplain
reviews.text: We had flights from Muscat to Manila and back,(Wy 843&844 specially 844.) flight and crew was fantastic but I am wondering why don't you give the Amuoje pack to business class passenger of Philippine as your promised, what is the deferent between Philippines and others countries passenger? The package is not important for busines class passenger but it disappointed me for this kind of discrimination. Please think about it. Thank you Zhila
reviews.author: Zhila S

reviews.title: Missed flight/bad customer service
reviews.text: We were meant to travel from Delhi to Muscat and from there further to Munich. The plane from Muscat to Delhi diverted from Delhi to Jaipur because of “fog” as the airline told us but during the same time flights from Virgin Atlantic and British Airways did land in Delhi so it cannot be a weather reason. When we asked a different agent he told us all refueling stations in Delhi had been busy and the airplane was running out of fuel so it diverted. We left Delhi with an almost three hour delay and missed our connecting flight in Muscat. Oman Air rebooked us on the same flight during the next day but did not help in securing our return on the same day which was quite unfortunate as both of us had work on Monday morning. We arrived with a 24 hour delay in Munich and missed an extra day of work. On the flight a day later we were not able to sit together which was also not ideal. Moral of the story: If you have important meetings, deadlines or appointments I would highly advise against Oman Air as they are unreliable and will not help you out when it comes to arrange alternative travel on the same day.
reviews.author: KP

reviews.title: Oman air cancelled my flight, try to call them for returning home with no any help and no refund
reviews.text: Oman air cancelled my flight, we try to get help to return home from Oman air and booking.com with no luck, I had to get another ticket with emirates for $5000 economy and staying in athens for another 5 days $1000 so big thanks to Oman air and booking.com giving me the round around for the last 6 months still trying to get refund for my original ticket pls do yourself a favour stay away from both of them
reviews.author: Angelos O

reviews.title: Very smart business tactics
reviews.text: This Oman Air together with its agents take 80% of your payment when giving refund. Before the refund they take 90% of your payment to change your ticket. Service onboard are as other companies, but better than low fare companies. If delays or cancellations there are no compensation unless EU 261 can be used.
reviews.author: Peter Leif Tron... P

reviews.title: Just a scam
reviews.text: Their website has an option to hold a booking for up to three days for a moderate non-refundable fee. I decided to use this option, and my card was charged to allow me to purchase tickets within the next three days. After two days I decided to exercise the option and pay for my tickets (the price went by 50% during these two days). After several attempts to reach the payment page (their website is often malfunctioning and would not recognize the booking after several attempts), it produced a "payment error" (I used the same card which was gladly charged a holding fee two days ago and two more different cards) and a suggestion to contact a local or main call center. The local call center responded that they can't do anything and is not related to web sales (and eventually hung up) and suggested to contact their main call center in Oman. I made two attemps to call them. The first guy said he would talk to his supervisor and asked me to forward the booking reference to their e-mail to resolve the issue. Needless to say, nothing happened, so I called again in few hours: another call center guy had offered me to make a new booking (i.e. at a 1.5X price). Numerous e-mails obviously remained unanswered, and my booking had expired with the holding fee successfuly pocketed by the airline. The fact that no attempt was made to resolve the payment issue on their side while the price went up considerably suggests this is just a small-scale scam: I strongly doubt I will be spending my time and nerves to reach them to recover the holding fee I paid. Likewise - to ever attempt to fly with them.
reviews.author: superzheka

reviews.title: No customer service. Grab your money and keep it!
reviews.text: I bought 2 flight tickets via an agent. An error caused the two different passenger names to be printed on the e-ticket as the same name. Oman Air refuse to correct the second name, despite having correct date of birth, passport, gender etc. details for that passenger. They also refuse to authorize the agent to make the correction. We will lose around £1400 due to this, which is so simple to correct. It would take someone under a minute to do. We are happy to pay a fee for the correction. Why are you so awkward Oman Air?
reviews.author: Martyn F

reviews.title: Not up to level of other gulf airlines but it works!
reviews.text: The web site needs work. Trying to buy a free middle seat defeated the most technologically proficient of the party. And they were available. Checking was quick and painless both ends. Bags delivered promptly. During the flight nothing much to report apart from fact that cabin became very stuffy and could have done with more oxygen! Head cleared as soon as I got off. No complaints apart from cost for direct flights.
reviews.author: John P

reviews.title: No complaints so far
reviews.text: Smooth check in, boarding process. Cabin cleanliness and cabin crew service was up to the mark. Extra leg space charges were little high as compared to Premium Economy class by other airlines.
reviews.author: MeenaRanade

reviews.title: Terrible attitude from a senior Oman Air employee
reviews.text: Me and my husband were flying from Muscat to Frankfurt. Our flight was at 2:45am so we reached the airport at 12am. Once we checked in our baggage we headed to the immigration. For some unknown reason the smart gate wasn't working so we had to queue to pass the immigration. We spent over an hour and 30 minutes just to complete the immigration process and rushed to the boarding gate. Upon arrival at the gate this older Oman Air staff started screaming at me and my husband for being late. Everyone waiting at the immigration was delayed because it was unusually busy and the ROP was not able to let people jump the queue. While we were at the immigration there were other airline employees coming looking for their passengers stuck at the immigration but no one from Oman Air came looking for us. We explained this to the guy on the boarding gate but he wouldn't stop screaming at us. This attitude was extremely rude and disrespectful. We will surely avoid traveling using Oman Air as much as possible after such horrible experience.
reviews.author: clara s

reviews.title: Really solid service
reviews.text: Equivalent to the other full-service carriers I've traveled with. Food was better than US ones (United, Delta etc.) as Oman Air actually have seasoning on their meals and aren't just bland chicken and vegetables. Seats were pretty comfortable and service was fine.
reviews.author: Seth B

reviews.title: Very nice expirience!
reviews.text: Absolutely nothing to complain about. Friendly staff, modern aircraft, good food, nice drinks. Plenty of legroom (184cm). I will book with them again!
reviews.author: hedersmannen

reviews.title: Flight from Australia to Germany
reviews.text: I was super surprised by this airline. I was quite nervous when I booked it, to the point I wasn't even sure I'd make it to Europe without a flight getting cancelled etc. since the reviews for Oman Air and Malindo Air are so bad online. I was proven wrong! Every Oman Air Flight left exactly on time, staff were professional, seats were comfortable, but the best part was the food!! By far the best airplane food I've had, and I've flown between Germany and Australia numerous times with the more expensive airlines. Also, on the Malindo Air flights, the passengers that were coming from Oman Air flights actually got given food. So yeah, I will definitely be booking these guys again - they were literally a few thousand dollars cheaper than the competition and the experience was pretty much the same.
reviews.author: Ric B

reviews.title: Nice aircraft
reviews.text: Qatar recently leased several aircrafts from Oman Air at the backdrop of demands arising out of World Cup. We got to fly one to Doha on our way to Washington. The plane was new and nice. Seats in the economy cabin were ok. I cannot comment about Omani crew as it was manned by Qatar Airways staff. The service was average and no particular complaints.
reviews.author: csserious2

reviews.title: Extremely unprofessional airline
reviews.text: Extremely unprofessional airline. Very rude ground staff apart from a couple of helpful people. The flights delay everyday on purpose by 3 hours at least(if you check statistics of the past month you’ll realise what i’m talking about). As a result, people lose connecting flights (my case). Food is not enough in portion and not tasty at all. Staff is extremely unhelpful and rude. Overall, I would never ever recommend this airline to anyone.
reviews.author: Alif A

reviews.title: Flight to cairo
reviews.text: Took a connecting flight from Delhi to cairo via Muscat. The legroom needs much improvement.it is a torture for a tall person.The flight from Delhi to Muscat was delayed...but no updates were provided as to when boarding would start.Food is average.Transit was like a breeze . overall not an experience to remember
reviews.author: Leeza H

reviews.title: Ok flight experience, horrendous customer service
reviews.text: I have nothing to say about the flight because I had decent with no hiccups. The crew was really accommodating. But I am really disappointed with the customer service. I lost an item at the airport and came to find out the lost and found section had it after a few days. When I went to retrieve it they wanted my boarding pass as proof of my travel. Now my mistake was that I got rid of them right after my travel, and I did in-person check-in since it was an international flight so I had no digital copy. I called Oman air (international call btw) to get a travel receipt as proof that I took the airline, which is a simple enough request that any airline should be able to provide. Well, the first agent had no idea and after talking to a supervisor said he will send it to my email within 5 minutes. 1 hour no email, so I called again. Another agent picked up the call and he also had no idea how to issue a travel receipt. He couldn't help me at all and to top it off, he was very rude and condescending. Now during the whole call, I was being polite and was explaining my side of the story as best as possible despite his rudness. But his attitude really pissed me off and I had to end the call frustrated, without getting any help or at the very least, a direction to solve my issue. So, I ended up at the same point where I started but few dollars poorer to make the useless calls.
reviews.author: Kshitij

reviews.title: Excellent comfort, service and friendliness
reviews.text: I recently flew Oman Air from Muscat to Frankfurt to connect to a Lufthansa flight to Los Angeles. I did not know much about Oman Air - it tends to be overshadowed by Emirates and Qatar Air in the region. I have to say the flight was excellent. They have a separate check-in area for Business passengers with comfortable seating and dedicated agents. The lounge was great. And the plane was new with aisle access for every seat. The seats reclined to a full bed big enough for me (6'4"). And the service was great. Highly recommend. Much better than Lufthansa.
reviews.author: Richard S

reviews.title: Non existence of Customer service Baggage loss
reviews.text: It's been 6 days since our luggage went missing and there has been no response to any emails from Oman air, no one answers the phone as well. It has the most pathetic service. I used to travel oman air often but not anymore. Its unreal that they don't reply and don't care.
reviews.author: sids1982

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE. DO NOT BOOK WITH THEM.
reviews.text: I had booked flights to Goa in February 2023. Just before Christmas I received a voicemail to say that my flights had been cancelled. The next day an email and text to say that a representative would be in contact to discuss my options. This never happened. I was then emailed re-issued flights on Boxing Day, which I had not been consulted on or agreed to. Despite sending 3 emails to request a full refund, I have heard nothing from Oman Air. The worst (non-existent) customer service that I have ever experienced!! I refuse to call their helpline because I've already spent over £100 due to the international costs. They should have contacted me. Do not book with Oman Air. I'm now considering escalating this to AMEX in order to get my money back and also reporting the airline to Ombudsman.
reviews.author: Kathryn L

reviews.title: Bad services of Oman Air
reviews.text: Luggage handling is very worst. I lost one of my luggage. Never ever travel with oman air. It was a bad experience to me as I lost all the valuable stuff. Useless Airline
reviews.author: Donatus L

reviews.title: Excellent ambassadors for Oman
reviews.text: This was our first trip with Oman Air and I cannot say enough about their friendly, professional staff. The check-in agents at Dubai went above and beyond to successfully resolve another airline’s baggage issue. The lounge in Muscat was spectacular. On board, the service was welcoming, with snacks provided even on short flights. The coffee and date welcome was our first experience of this Omani tradition and was a lovely start to a fantastic vacation there. As a side note, airports in Oman are lovely, and calm, with interesting furnishing and indoor gardens.
reviews.author: Margy M

reviews.title: Worst Airline
reviews.text: Terrible experience from start to finish. Very rude and aggressive manager at check-in. His problem was being made mine. Told me to go and sit down and wait to be told when I could travel. My error was booking a seat blocker. He took no interest in my medical issues. A lady reporting to him was lovely and tried to help. The review I saw about the speed of descent I agree with. Our flight had one of the hardest hits onto the runway I have ever experienced.
reviews.author: David B
